method: Root examined all 77 original/new pairs decoded from completed movies at matched timestamps: squeegee passes, registration, three full landscape prints, progressively revealed exact trail statistics, gallery wall and final credit pass. Independent worker checked 11 repeated seeks.
audio_evidence: No narration in the original or recreation. Fresh 357 sampled notes, 101 percussion hits and 104 material/ambience cues; music pauses at 18–19.2 and 23.4–24 seconds retain ambience. Final AAC -13.9 LUFS / -1.2 dBTP.
comparison_notes: Source-informed full-length recreation using attributed complete landscape-plane artwork and reusable print/silkscreen tools. New scene/camera/bench/wall/ending assembly, folk score and foley. Fine squeegee phase, ink edge, wood, paper and registration behavior differ. This is not a blind model benchmark.
